schema:name: Health worker density at subnational level; distribution by facility ownership and by facility type (1-02, 1-05, 1-06)
schema:description: 1-02: "Density of active health workers per 10 000 population at subnational level." 1-05: "Percentage of active health workers employed by facility ownership." 1-06: "Percentage of active health workers employed by facility type." Part of Module 1. Each worker's facility comes from the facility registry. Term indicator-1-02, indicator-1-05, indicator-1-06 in the nhwa-2023 glossary (litlfred/who-iris glossary/nhwa-2023.glossary.json), from National health workforce accounts: a handbook, 2nd ed. (WHO 2023, ISBN 9789240081291).
